hashes.hash_note: Driver hash updated after the measured maps to add derived two-grid secant diagnostics; no reference maps were rerun in this post-processing.

limitations: This is a fixed-background Reference-map sensitivity check; it does not invoke the iterative Reference self_consistent solver.
The two slopes are interval secants over x0 to x1 and x0 to xsecant, not rigorous local derivatives.
The adaptive/native two-grid secant estimates are a convergence screen, not a formal interval enclosure or quadrature bound.
